content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, Venezuela, and Pakistan, digital creators face a significant [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-8|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] problem: accessing reliable payment gateways for their digital products. With platforms like Stripe and PayPal severely restricted or unavailable, creators are left with limited [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/top-7-options-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-beats-online-crypto-payments-first-principles-definitive-5|Selling Beats]]-digital-products-africa-ranked-2|options]] to sell their ebooks, courses, and templates. This post breaks down the solution to this problem, focusing on crypto payment gateways that enable creators to sell digital products without relying on conventional platforms.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-14. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

The solution to the payment gateway problem lies in leveraging crypto payment gateways, which allow creators to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies. This approach matters because it offers a decentralized, low-fee, and secure way to receive payments, bypassing traditional platforms like Gumroad, which charges a 10% fee on every sale. In contrast, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, retaining more revenue for the creator.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a crypto payment gateway for digital products involves several components working together seamlessly. It starts with a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which provides a free and reliable way to host the digital store. The backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which automates tasks like order processing and product delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order information, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 enable instant product delivery.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are restricted or unavailable. These creators produce high-quality digital products like ebooks, courses, templates, and software but face significant barriers in monetizing their work due to payment infrastructure limitations. By utilizing crypto payment gateways, they can now reach a global audience and receive payments securely and efficiently.
Leverage crypto payment gateways to sell digital products without traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Several key components make this solution work. Firstly, NOWPayments provides automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a low 0.5% fee, significantly reducing the cost compared to traditional platforms. Secondly, the use of Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages for hosting and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic ensures a scalable and reliable infrastructure. Lastly, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery complete the ecosystem, allowing for seamless product distribution.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by selecting the appropriate components based on their needs. They can choose from pre-designed stacks like the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack, each offering a comprehensive solution with varying levels of complexity and support. By following the documentation provided with these stacks, creators can set up their own crypto payment gateways and start selling digital products without relying on traditional platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can leverage crypto payment gateways like NOWPayments, which integrate with their digital stores hosted on platforms like GitHub Pages. This approach allows for automatic payment verification and product delivery, all while avoiding the high fees associated with traditional payment platforms. For instance, at 100 sales per month of a $97 product, using NOWPayments instead of Gumroad retains $921 in fees alone.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than Gumroad's 10% fee.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a crypto payment gateway for digital products, start by selecting a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate order processing and product delivery. Then, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment verification, and choose Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Finally, configure Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for instant file delivery, and test your setup to ensure seamless transactions. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore pre-designed stacks that simplify this process.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is NOWPayments and how does it work?
NOWPayments is a crypto payment gateway that enables automatic on-chain payment verification with a 0.5% fee, allowing creators to receive payments securely and efficiently.
Can I use this solution for selling digital downloads?
Yes, this solution is ideal for selling digital downloads like ebooks, courses, and templates, as it provides instant product delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
How do I integrate crypto payments into my digital store?
Integrate crypto payments by setting up NOWPayments with your chosen hosting and backend logic solutions, such as GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers.
What are the benefits of using a crypto payment gateway?
Benefits include low transaction fees, decentralized and secure payments, and the ability to reach a global audience without relying on traditional payment platforms.

Yes, this solution is scalable, thanks to the use of reliable hosting and backend logic solutions like Cloudflare Pages and Workers, which can handle large volumes of transactions efficiently.
